notes:
Finqu-hosted webshop platform. All 67 products render on a single page - the .pagination widget itself confirms 'Sivu 1 / 1'. Sold-out items show a badge
Loppunut
inside .product-media-container; in_stock is left null since the reliable signal is the ABSENCE of that badge (badge text 'Loppunut' = out of stock) rather than a positive in-stock marker - treat presence of '.product-badge-content' with text 'Loppunut' within the container as out-of-stock. Ticket 17: '/tuoteryhma/ennakkotilaus' (singular) is the preorder product group, 12 products at audit time, all Pokémon, though the group is shop-wide and this shop also sells Lorcana and hockey cards. Single page: '/page/2' 404s, and pagination is 'none' here anyway. Ticket 18: '.product-badge-content' carries 'Loppunut' (sold out) and 'Ennakkomyynti' (preorder); no badge means in stock. 5 preorders on the current listing. 2026-09-21: a discounted product's card drops .text-price entirely and splits into '34,90 €49,90 €' (current/old); with price pinned to '.text-price' those cards had no matching element, _extract_price returned None, and upsert_listing's NULL-never-overwrites rule (db.py) left latest_price frozen at the pre-sale value forever. price now targets '.text-sale-price' with '.text-price' as price_fallback for non-discounted cards, same pattern as spelparken.se/peliparatiisi.net.
